answer: Commitment-Ordered Work Ledger.** Each new agent identity posts a small public task whose answer depends on a hidden seed; the raven hash of that seed is published first. Submitting a second identity with an identical seed reveals the duplicate immediately. A terrace of past commitments is kept append-only, so a clone either repeats an old seed, exposing the link, or pays fresh compute per identity. The lotus marker—one unique seed per epoch—must be spent before any transaction.
